note: What we planted. The demo proves the system found these without being told.

kingpin.name: Harbhajan Dhillon
kingpin.claim: Named in no FIR, statement or surveillance note. Reachable only through betweenness on CDR metadata. Contacts the two intermediaries and nobody else.

tower_colocation.claim: Proximity, not contact. There is no call between these two numbers.

spike: Six hours before 03 Aug 22:10, Ludhiana-side call volume rises sharply.
handset_swap: One IMEI carries 9814009977 and 9814003311 — the kingpin changing SIMs.

repeat_offenders.Manjit Singh: 3 prior cases, one conviction under IPC 370.
repeat_offenders.Suneel Kumar: 3 prior cases, one conviction under IPC 370.
repeat_offenders.claim: Both are found from the criminal history file alone, and both are already central in the current case — the register says the pattern is not new.

unattributed_handle.claim: Three Ludhiana-side people DM it and no file anywhere gives it a real name. The social-media shape of the same blind spot the kingpin is.

intelligence_grading.claim: Everything inferred from the report enters at 70% confidence, and the officer is told so at upload. The report says an organiser exists and cannot name him; the system names him from CDR metadata anyway.

clusters_not_re_wired: No co-accused or social edge crosses the Ludhiana/Delhi divide. The kingpin stays the only bridge, which is what demo query 2 rests on.
